title: Snowflake on the Painted Rock
verses: I saw the bees on three flowers
I heard the skull at seventy-two
A drop froze into a name
The house did not rename itself
Steam above the spring is still water
Winter on the caldera is still the rock
chorus: snowflake not snow / paint what you hear / sing what you learn / feed the fire

chirp_map.note: same frequencies as ears.js  the song IS the hearing, sung outward
